## 1 · The data

| Item | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **time** | follow-up from **time zero** to the event or censoring (one unit) |
| **status** | 1 = event, 0 = censored |
| **censored** | observed event-free up to a time, then unknown (alive at the end, **lost to follow-up**) |
| `Surv(time, status)` | the survival object; **`17.2+`** = censored at 17.2 |

Our cohort: 600 patients, **113 deaths** (19%), 487 censored.

## 2 · Which method?

| Question | Method | R |
|---|---|---|
| How is survival over time? | **Kaplan-Meier** | `survfit(Surv(t, s) ~ 1)` |
| Survival at 12 months? | KM at a time | `summary(km, times = 12)` |
| Do two or more curves differ? | **Log-rank** | `survdiff(Surv(t, s) ~ g)` |
| Effect size, adjusted for covariates | **Cox regression** | `coxph(Surv(t, s) ~ x1 + x2)` |
| Event rate per person-time | rate | `events / sum(time) * 100` |
| Typical follow-up | **reverse KM** | `survfit(Surv(t, 1 - s) ~ 1)` |
| Is the HR constant over time? | PH test | `cox.zph(fit)` |

## 3 · Reading the output

| Result | How to say it |
|---|---|
| KM at 12 months: 0.83 | "83% were alive 12 months after starting treatment (95% CI 80–86%)" |
| Median = `NA` | "median not reached": fewer than half died; report survival at fixed times |
| Log-rank p | "survival differed (p = ...)": direction from **observed vs expected** |
| **HR** = exp(coef) | "at any time, the hazard is **HR times** that of the reference group" |
| HR for HIV: **1.80** (1.10–2.95) | "about 80% higher hazard of death in HIV-positive patients" |
| CI includes **1** | no clear association |

**HR is a rate ratio, not a risk ratio.** Rescale continuous variables (per 10 years, per 5 kg/m²).

## 4 · Cox model checklist

1. **Events per coefficient** about 10 or more: here 14.1
2. Choose covariates **from theory** (not p-values); report **crude and adjusted** HRs and **reference groups**
3. **Check PH**: `cox.zph()` and a plot; one borderline term among many may be chance
4. If violated: **`strata()`** (nuisance factor), **time-split** (`survSplit`) to report the effect by period, or time-varying effects
5. Report with `tbl_regression(fit, exponentiate = TRUE)`

## 5 · Pitfalls

::: {.bad}
- **Mean** of follow-up times or a **t-test** on them; **proportion died** when follow-up differs
- Median **replaced** by the median of observed times when it is "not reached"
- Reading the **thin right tail** of a KM curve; no **number at risk**
- **Informative censoring** (the sickest are lost); **competing risks** ignored
- **Immortal time bias**; different **time zero** in the groups
- HR read as **risk ratio**; one HR reported when the effect **changes over time**
- Too few events for the covariates; **association read as cause**
:::

## 6 · One-paragraph report

*Of 600 patients (median follow-up 18 months by reverse Kaplan-Meier), 113 died and 487 were censored. Twelve-month survival was 83% (95% CI 80–86%). In a multivariable Cox model, HIV (HR 2.0) and MDR-TB (HR 2.1) were associated with a higher hazard of death and DOT with a lower hazard (HR 0.6); smear status violated proportional hazards and was stratified.*

:::
